title: Understanding Bootstrap Replicates
text: Bootstrap replicates are used to estimate the sampling distribution of a statistic by resampling with replacement from the original data. In this table, each row represents a bootstrap sample, and each column represents a replicate.

title: Analyzing the Table
text: The table shows replicates in columns and bootstrap samples in rows. The rowmeans, rowvars, and rowmedians are calculated for each row, while colmeans, colvars, and colmedians are calculated for each column.

title: Decreasing Variance of Sample Mean
text: To decrease the variance of the sample mean, consider increasing the sample size or the number of bootstrap replicates. Both actions can lead to a more stable estimate of the mean.
